cover.alt: Gisele Bündchen radiates pinup energy against a saturated cerulean blue backdrop, posing in a plunging short-sleeved Balmain mini-dress in vivid emerald green, embellished with intricate 3D rose motifs in soft pink and silver beadwork cascading down the front. Her tousled honey-blonde waves frame her face dramatically, paired with sculptural drop earrings, a wide cuff bracelet, and a confident hand-on-hip stance. Pink caged stiletto sandals complete the look. The bold "BALMAIN PARIS" wordmark sits centered over the composition — pure retro pinup glamour meets Rousteing's rose-garden romance.

Her tousled honey-blonde waves frame her face dramatically, paired with sculptural drop earrings, a wide cuff bracelet, and a confident hand-on-hip stance. Pink caged stiletto sandals complete the look. The bold "BALMAIN PARIS" wordmark sits centered over the composition — pure retro pinup glamour meets Rousteing's rose-garden romance.

Pure Rousteing maximalism on a powder-pink backdrop. Gisele wears an off-shoulder Balmain mini-dress encrusted with dense 3D floral embellishment — emerald-green palm-like foliage erupting across a black-and-white polka-dot base, dotted with raised pink rose clusters and crystal accents. Her windswept blonde waves cascade like a lion's mane, paired with statement floral chandelier earrings and a chunky turquoise-and-pink jeweled cuff. She carries Balmain's sculptural curved-handle handbag in glossy black-and-white. A baroque garden in dress form — that's the rose-garden moment. ​

Gisele goes full pop-art bombshell against blush pink. The strapless Balmain mini-dress is rendered in glossy tangerine-orange latex, swarmed with sculptural multicolor 3D roses in coral pink, butter yellow, powder blue, and emerald green — bursting diagonally across the bodice like a 3D bouquet. Her tousled hair flies in every direction like a manga heroine. She accessorizes with stacked glitter-and-resin cuff bracelets in orange, blue, and turquoise, and clutches a lattice-cut Balmain bag in chartreuse green with gold "B" plaque. Plastic-fantastic glam meets couture craftsmanship. ​

Gisele serves Pretty Woman-meets-pinup against a buttery banana-yellow backdrop, wearing a plunging long-sleeved Balmain mini-dress in bubblegum pink satin scattered with oversized black polka dots. A single oversized 3D rose blooms at the bust, echoing the campaign's floral DNA. Her honey-blonde waves are caught mid-flight in a windswept wave, paired with a sleek black wrist cuff, scarlet manicure, and crisp white pointed-toe pumps. She holds a structured white top-handle Balmain bag with gold "B" hardware — playful retro Americana filtered through couture polish. ​
